title: asset.rejected payload
description: Emitted by MAM when an asset is rejected in review. Consumed by Notifications, Logging.

createdBy.description: Who created the asset — told of a verdict on it (EP-25.5).

categoryPath.description: The asset's category path, resolved when the event was made — what a recipient's read access is checked against (EP-25.5).

retainUntil.description: When the rejected media is purged if not replaced first (FR-APP-8). Absent = kept until manual/policy disposition.

reviewPointId.description: Optional id of the workflow review step that produced this verdict (FR-APP-5).
